title: Greg Abbott's Staff Met Secretly With Big Tech to Ease Data Center Grid Access
summary:
The governor of Texas's top aides held private sessions with industry representatives to streamline the process of bringing more data centers to the state. Two days after these closed-door meetings, the Electric Reliability Council of Texas, known as ERCOT, announced a plan to accelerate the timeline for connecting these facilities to the state's power grid.

The effort to remove barriers for the technology sector contradicts public statements from Gov. Greg Abbott, who has questioned the rapid expansion of data centers. A report from Politico, citing internal records and interviews, indicates that Abbott's office and his appointees have worked closely with the power and tech industries to facilitate the growth of the facilities.
